verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect documents scheduling the frequency of automatic payouts for connected accounts and managing payouts per connected account. It also documents Instant Payouts that let connected accounts access their balances right after a successful charge. Together these cover the core of per-seller scheduled and instant payouts, but the snippets are thin. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the daily/weekly/monthly/manual intervals, explicit per-seller configurability, detail on instant payouts to debit cards or real-time rails and where they are supported, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
